full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE TAPAT NA PALAUD. Mr. Allan Manato allanlmanato@yahoo.com 0999-906-5779 Dear Mr. Manato, Legal Opinion No. 41 s. 2011 JUL 2 0 2011 This pertains to your e-mail query regarding the application of Memorandum Order No. 14 (MO No. 14) issued by the Office of the President on 29 April 2011 to implement the provisions of Republic Act (RA) No. 6686 entitled "AN ACT AUTHORIZING ANNUAL CHRISTMAS BONUS TO NATIONAL AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES STARTING CY 1988," as amended by RA No. 8441. In particular, you were inquiring whether MO No. 14, which mandates all national government agencies, government-owned or controlled corporations (GOCCs) and local government units (LGUs) to start the process of payment of one-half of the Year-End Bonus and Cash Gift to their employees on 01 May 2011, covers all local elective officials. We answer your query in the affirmative. Section 3 of MO No. 14 states that the payment of the said benefit shall be in accordance with the guidelines prescribed under DBM Budget Circular No. 2010-1 dated 28 April 2010. In connection therewith, item No. 3.0 of DBM Budget Circular No. 2010-1 provides, and we quote: "3.0 Coverage The following personnel are covered by this circular: 3.1 Civilian government personnel occupying regular, contractual, or casual positions; appointive or elective; rendering services on full- time or part-time basis; 3.2 xxx. " (Emphasis ours). Based on the foregoing, it is clear that all elective officials of barangays, municipalities, cities, and provinces are covered by the provisions of MO No. 14. We hope to have informed you accordingly. Very truly yours, AT . JESU B.D Director III Legal:03
